title.text: 15 · Ferro: Same surface, different magnets: one real NSE surface fitted twice, drawn as ferrofluid over magnets, in chrome and liquid black.

plan.text:
Ferro. Same surface, different magnets: one real NSE surface fitted twice, drawn as ferrofluid over magnets, in chrome and liquid black.

Layout: One chrome plate hero, then calm two-column sections split by ferrofluid ridges; black carries emphasis, not colour.
The memorable thing: Bharti Airtel's 39-day smile as a pool of ferrofluid that two very different fits raise identically; their ten settings drawn as spike strips.
Type: Sora 600–700 for headlines and numbers; Epilogue 400–800 for text; emphasis by weight, never by hue.
Light: bg #E9EBEE, surf #F5F6F8, ink #0A0A0A, muted #50555D, acc #0A0A0A, line #B4BAC3
Dark: bg #050505, surf #121314, ink #F2F2F2, muted #9A9DA3, acc #D9DCE1, line #36383C
Magnet rail on the right edge. Live prices on these boards are NSE closing prices from 25 Sep 2026; every chart is drawn from real data or the project's pricer.
